scope_notes: This replaces the historical fixed-100 budget for the paper-primary experiment path.
Calibration uses completed Qwen seed-1 wall times and the latest live LongBench rolling rate; the 25% contingency remains outside expected spend.
All suites are sequential and resumable; no remote timer, watcher, or power action is installed.
The queue intentionally includes both model families, three strict training seeds, core rule/NoLiMa/LongBench evidence, and representative MMLU/IFEval/mechanism checks.
The recommended amount is a reserve ceiling, not a target to spend; completed artifacts are skipped only after schema and hash gates pass.
